question: Gross primary deficit is the difference between ______.

options.text: gross fiscal deficit and interest receipts
gross fiscal deficit and net interest liabilities

solution:
The correct answer is** __gross fiscal deficit and net interest liabilities__**.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gross primary deficit** refers to the **difference between the current year's fiscal deficit and interest payments made on the previous year's borrowings.**
 
• In other words,** it represents the fiscal deficit of the government excluding interest payments.**
 
• This provides a measure of the **amount of borrowing the government needs to cover expenses other than interest payments.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue deficit :**

 
 
• According to the overall** revenue receipts and budgeted expenses,** a revenue deficit shows **debt in the current budget.**
 
• The revenue spending** exceeds **the revenue receipt in this circumstance.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal deficit:**
 
 
• The fiscal deficit is a metric that demonstrates the **extent of the government's reliance on borrowing.**
 
• The **country's government's estimated borrowings** are reflected in the fiscal deficit.
 
• So the b**igger the fiscal deficit**, the higher the** government borrowings** will be.​
